page.title: Parcels
page.description: Your parcels sent and received over the last 30 days.

package.title: Package
package.sendHint: Creates a code to give the recipient. The lots stay with you, reserved, until they accept it.

sent.title: Parcel sealed
sent.description: Give this code to the player who should receive it.
sent.waiting: Waiting for the recipient · expires in {remaining}
sent.reservedHint: These quantities are reserved: they cannot go in another parcel. They leave your inventory when the recipient accepts.

receive.title: Receive a parcel
receive.description: Type or paste the code the sender gave you.
receive.receivedDescription: {created, plural, one {# lot created} other {# lots created}}, {merged, plural, one {# lot topped up} other {# lots topped up}}.
receive.codeHint: 8 characters, letters and digits. Dashes, spaces and lower case are fine.
receive.from: {sender} is sending you {count, plural, one {# lot} other {# lots}}.
receive.mergeHint: A matching lot already stored there will be topped up.

list.emptySent: No parcel sent. Prepare one from the inventory.
list.hint: A cancelled or expired parcel moved nothing: its lots stayed with the sender. A code works once.

errors.invalid_code: That is not a parcel code: 8 letters or digits.
errors.invalid_items: The package holds a lot that is no longer in your inventory.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many wrong codes: try again in a few minutes.
errors.own_parcel: This is your own parcel: give the code to another player.
errors.unavailable: {item}: the quantity is no longer available.
